name: @pipeworx/mcp-oh-medical-exclusions

tools.name: oh_medical_check_exclusion
tools.description: Is this healthcare provider excluded from, or suspended from, the Ohio Medicaid program? Screens a person or organization name, an NPI, and/or an ODM Provider ID against the Ohio Department of Medicaid (ODM) Provider Exclusion & Suspension List — the state-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (see the leie pack) for Ohio specifically, and the sibling of ny_omig_check_exclusion (New York), ca_medical_check_exclusion (California), tx_medical_check_exclusion (Texas), fl_medical_check_exclusion (Florida), pa_medical_check_exclusion (Pennsylvania) and ga_medical_check_exclusion (Georgia). Answers "is this provider excluded from Ohio Medicaid", "check this NPI against the Ohio ODM exclusion list", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for an Ohio Medicaid provider. An NPI or Provider ID match is an IDENTIFICATION (both are exact identifiers ODM assigns/records, and either can be a comma-joined list on one row when a provider is excluded under multiple registrations); a name match — even an exact one — is a CANDIDATE lead only, since this list carries no date of birth. Every match carries ODM's own Status field (Excluded, Suspended, or occasionally Terminated/blank) and a currently_excluded flag DERIVED from it — null with status_unknown:true when the status is not a recognized Excluded/Suspended value, rather than a guess. Pass npi or provider_id to turn a name lead into an identification. Sourced from the Ohio ODM Provider Exclusion & Suspension List, keyless.

name.description: Provider or organization name to screen, e.g. "John Smith" or "Acme Home Health". Matched against the provider's individual name and organization name, any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification rather than a name lead — always pass it when known.

provider_id.description: ODM's own Provider ID, if known. A Provider ID match is an identification.

tools.name: oh_medical_exclusion_coverage
tools.description: What the Ohio ODM exclusion/suspension data covers and how current it is: total rows (individuals plus organizations), how many are currently excluded/suspended vs. status-unknown, how many carry an NPI, and the oldest/newest exclusion effective date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line note on the status field's gaps. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 2,100+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Ohio ODM exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (action_date / ODM's Action Date — never date_added, which answers a different question and gives a different number). Sourced from the Ohio ODM Provider Exclusion & Suspension List, keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-oh-medical-exclusions forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the oh-medical-exclusions pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
